line: Used to carry bottles to the store Thinkin’ to myself like I can’t do this shit no more
vault_lines: Used to carry bottles to the store
meaning:
Tee Grizzley’s home state of Michigan is one of ten states in the U.S with container deposit legislation, offering a per-bottle/soda can recycling refund usually between 5 to 10 cents. Deposit machines are commonly found at the entrance of grocery stores or other retail locations.



In a recent interview with Noisey, Grizzley spoke on depositing bottles:

I need to talk about this struggle and how I feel people did me…Like, I talked about carrying bottles to the store when I was young. I know everybody didn’t carry bottles to the store before…but that’s what makes me unique.

As a large number of deposits only amounts to a few dollars, one can quickly become frustrated when using the refunds to make ends meet. You can learn more about Grizzley’s rise to fame despite the odds in this XXL article.
